newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh raises petrol price by up to 57 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh raises petrol price by up to 57 pct.

text.p: Bangladesh raised retail prices of petroleum products by up to 57 percent on Tuesday in view of higher international fuel prices and the devaluation of the taka, an official announcement said.
It said: "The prices of petroleum products have been refixed considering the devaluation of the Bangladesh taka against the U.S. dollar as well as the international market."
The decision was taken at a cabinet meeting chaired by Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina on Monday.
The price of octane rose to 23 taka per litre from 14.65, petrol 21 taka per litre from 13.7 and diesel 12.95 per litre from 12.7.
